config.admission: prospective protocol; tested implementation and local base/optional checks; both source-bound hosted code CI jobs; published source-bound correctness and all216 timing rows/forecast; checked admission before10m learning; own before comparison-only native audit
config.averages: one linear primary ledger and one uniform side ledger on each shared learning path; average weight does not enter regrets/current/RNG; two readouts are dependent, not independent learners
config.baseline: B1 delegates unchanged cached-node step; both readout state/policy/work/iteration/initialization prefixes must match original archived 100k/1m/10m exactly on original runtime; all 24 B1 paths pass before any B4/B16 10m paths
config.controls: reuse 48 original full work profiles once, not newly trained or independent seed replicates; B1 fresh copies explicitly labeled baseline replays
config.correctness: nonuniform Kuhn exact adaptive-selector expectations; B2 Cartesian-product variance halving; Jensen/clipping nonlinearity; independent dense frozen-batch trajectory parity; dual-book B1 bit identity; observer/serialization/receipt corruption, partial grids and barriers
config.initialization: unchanged simultaneous uniform exact warm start, iteration 1 and 2N charged visits
config.interpretation: within-pass averaging reduces conditional raw-update variance at fixed policy; at fixed node work it also reduces update count and changes iteration weighting. Learning outcomes cannot isolate a pure variance effect or establish global Holdem strength
metrics: EV/exact exploitability/within partition gain/extra exact information in chips and percent initial pot
average mass coverage and warm-only versus post-warm coverage

native_reference.name: OpenSpiel
native_reference.role: comparison-only scalar EV/exact+restricted roots/achieved OWN replies and river hybrids for all 480 profiles; no reference strategy export or training

config.partial: persist every attempt, worker event and completed snapshot; no overwrite or incomplete grid declared complete

prefix_runtime.requirement: recorded source runtime; any poker state/policy/work prefix mismatch stops without loosening precision; base 3.12 report replay is a separate tolerance-based check

profile.forecast: per path maximum of three setup+warm + incremental_seconds * (10000000-initialization_visits)/actual_incremental_visits; separate B1 and B4/B16 sorted index-mod-three partitions; sum the two maximum partition totals
profile.required: strictly below 7200 before long learning; retain failure, no reduced grid/work or relaxed allowance; prefixes are new postflop training but not strength outcomes

quality_gate.primary: B4 signed regrets, linear regret weights, linear average, texture_range_q8_b8; B1 baseline and B16 dose control
quality_gate.reporting: all modes/seeds/checkpoints, arithmetic means and individual points; no seed-population CI or favorable-subset report; compare original known-game thresholds descriptively only; any later admission requires its own prospective protocol
quality_gate.scope: diagnostic only; no family selected or admitted as agent/default/fresh/global in this protocol

retained_observations.purpose: offline normalization, post-warm support and current-movement replay; no extra training path or score selection
retained_observations.warm_origin: reconstruct both books from the frozen two simultaneous uniform expected passes at t=1; no trainer/random draws

config.scope: simulation-only known-game diagnostic; fixed old seeds/work/action/ranges/representations; no new feature, reset, budget extension or commercial/reference training targets
config.update: target 0 then target 1; B independent external traversals at one frozen target policy; sum sparse increments in traversal/key encounter order, divide by B once, apply one original time-weighted update; clipping after mean; charge every visited node; target 1 observes target 0 update
